towns.name: Danby's Outpost
towns.summary: Danby's Outpost (23.4N 28.7W) was founded in 12 PY by Gunther Danby the cook and his wife Greta the bowyer, a fortified welcome stop on the way to the Direlands, introduced in The Changing of the Ways; it sits on a z 14 shelf about 130 m back from the north shore of the Inner Sea, with the Desert March portal (shortcut to the Dires) down on the beach. It is a compact 57 m square stockade: 5 m stone-and-timber walls with a gate on the south side, two 31 m stone towers with spire roofs on the northern corners, and inside a courtyard with a stone fire ring where Gunther cooks, the Life Stone, the Town Network portal and the shopkeepers (Greta the Bowyer, Weaponsmith Hideo Sasaki, Pricilla the Healer, Abia bint Huda the Archmage). Forest giants 30-75 m tall stand around it and the land rises north to z 38.
